scope: Six representative missense-specific predictors for human germline SNVs; not an exhaustive catalog or comparative performance ranking.
method: Manual review of developer documentation, published methods and release/source metadata. Facts and URLs are bundled to reproduce this dated survey offline; rerunning does not refresh the literature.
version_policy: Releases identify reviewed software, score exports or publications. Pinned source revisions identify documentation/code. The accompanying benchmark uses the pinned 2023 AlphaMissense hg38 score archive.
compute_policy: Compute entries summarize documented execution routes. CPU lookup guidance is a workflow inference, not a runtime benchmark.

tools.name: SIFT4G
tools.method: Protein sequence conservation and tolerated amino-acid substitutions.
tools.variants: Missense substitutions; transcript/protein mapping is required for genomic SNVs.
tools.inputs: Protein FASTA queries and a homologous protein sequence database.
tools.access: Public local implementation; annotation databases must match the selected species and reference.
tools.compute: CPU supported; optional CUDA acceleration for database construction/scoring.
tools.license: Implementation: GPL-3.0; external sequence database terms are separate.
tools.training: Evolutionary protein sequence alignments; no clinical-label fitting in the core scoring method.
tools.clinvar: This review does not establish independence of every distributed database or later benchmark.
tools.caution: A protein-impact score is not a calibrated disease probability; missing mappings and alignments limit applicability.

tools.name: PolyPhen-2
tools.inputs: Protein accession, residue position and amino-acid substitution; genomic mapping is also available.
tools.access: Web interface, standalone software and precomputed annotations.
tools.compute: CPU lookup or local scoring with protein/structure databases.
tools.license: Academic instruction/research use; other use requires the authors' commercial license.
tools.training: HumDiv/HumVar include known disease/function variants and neutral comparators.
tools.clinvar: Disease variants can recur in ClinVar even though the original training sources were different.
tools.caution: Audit the exact model and training overlap; useful as a historical comparator, not an assumed independent reference.

tools.name: REVEL
tools.variants: Missense SNVs with valid protein/transcript mappings.
tools.inputs: Genomic alleles plus transcript/amino-acid mapping; some lifted GRCh38 positions are missing.
tools.compute: CPU lookup; relatively little work after downloading and indexing scores.
tools.license: Scores: non-commercial use; contact authors for other uses.
tools.training: HGMD disease variants and rare neutral variants; constituents bring their own training histories.
tools.clinvar: ClinVar was a published evaluation set; overlapping variants and inherited labels remain concerns.
tools.caution: Use only with an explicit overlap audit and report mapping failures rather than treating absent scores as benign.

tools.name: AlphaMissense
tools.method: Protein structure/evolution model with population-frequency supervision.
tools.variants: Human missense substitutions in the released transcript/protein catalog.
tools.inputs: Exact GRCh38 alleles for this benchmark; retain transcript/protein annotations from the published score file.
tools.access: Public precomputed predictions and reference code; trained weights are not provided.
tools.compute: CPU lookup of the score release; new inference cannot be reproduced from the published code alone.
tools.license: Code: Apache-2.0. Later official README: predictions CC BY 4.0; pinned 2023 archive header: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Both statements are retained in provenance.
tools.training: Human/primate population-frequency labels; core model is not fitted directly to ClinVar classifications.
tools.clinvar: Released scores are calibrated and category thresholds selected using ClinVar; clinical benchmarking is also reported.
tools.caution: Use continuous scores and audit calibration membership; do not describe this as wholly ClinVar-independent.

tools.name: EVE
tools.method: Protein-family generative model followed by mixture-model scoring.
tools.variants: Missense substitutions for proteins and positions covered by the released models.
tools.inputs: Protein/residue mapping for lookup; a protein-family MSA for new model fitting.
tools.access: Public score browser/downloads and code for rebuilding models.
tools.compute: CPU lookup; fitting new protein-family models requires MSA preparation and substantial compute.
tools.license: Code: MIT; confirm the terms of any separately downloaded dataset.
tools.training: Evolutionary MSAs; the core workflow requires no clinical labels.
tools.clinvar: ClinVar labels are supplied for evaluation, separate from MSA model fitting.
tools.caution: Coverage and homologous-sequence exposure still matter; external clinical calibration would need a separate audit.

tools.name: PrimateAI-3D
tools.release: 2023 method; reviewed PyTorch source revision pinned
tools.method: Protein-structure and evolutionary model informed by primate variation.
tools.inputs: Score lookup by genomic/protein mapping; local models use structure and evolutionary features.
tools.access: Browser and downloadable scores after an academic license agreement; source repository available.
tools.compute: CPU score lookup; new predictions require the model and structure/sequence resources.
tools.license: Scores: academic non-profit research agreement; commercial scores/models require separate licensing.
tools.training: Common human/primate variation with structural and evolutionary learning objectives.
tools.clinvar: The authors report clinical benchmarking without relying on clinical annotations for core training.
tools.caution: Exact population and protein overlap are not audited here; availability is gated by the score agreement.

shortlist.reason: Public GRCh38 allele scores make CPU lookup practical without model weights, protein remapping or gated access. Measure pilot coverage and validation ranking against ClinVar; retain the clinical-calibration caveat.

evaluation_rules: Retain Q1 membership and checksums in data/clinvar-train-pilot.vcf and data/clinvar-test-pilot.vcf; the latter is validation, with no independent test set.
Match only exact GRCh38 alleles. Use the maximum continuous score over matching transcript annotations, fixed before loading outcomes. Retain all annotations and report coverage by split and class.
Leave unmatched variants unscored. Ranking metrics apply only to covered validation variants; no benign imputation or claims about missing variants.
ClinVar remains the ground truth. Clinical assertions and label-derived annotations never enter score lookup; no fitting, threshold tuning or recalibration occurs.
Rerun Q1 full-cohort and sequence audits. They certify local partition separation, not independence of AlphaMissense protein/evolutionary data or its ClinVar calibration set.
Use 1000 component-bootstrap replicates with seed 42 for percentile 95% intervals. These are development results, not an independent clinical validation or tool ranking.
conclusion: The missense catalog covers SIFT4G, PolyPhen-2, REVEL, AlphaMissense, EVE and PrimateAI-3D. AlphaMissense is selected as the practical reference predictor using its public GRCh38 score release. ClinVar remains the ground truth. Coverage and validation performance are measured in the accompanying benchmark; clinical calibration overlap remains unresolved.
